parameters.query:
INSERT INTO jobs (
  source, source_job_id, company, title, location, remote,
  employment_type, url, description, salary, posted_at,
  language, skills, status, filter_passed
) VALUES (
  '{{ $json.source }}',
  '{{ $json.source_job_id }}',
  '{{ $json.company.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.title.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.location || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  {{ $json.remote || false }},
  '{{ $json.employment_type || "full-time" }}',
  '{{ $json.url }}',
  '{{ ($json.description || "").replace(/'/g, "''").substring(0, 6000) }}',
  {{ $json.salary ? "'" + $json.salary + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.posted_at ? "'" + $json.posted_at + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  'en',
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.skills || []) }}'::jsonb,
  'DISCOVERED',
  true
)
ON CONFLICT (source, source_job_id) DO NOTHING
RETURNING id, company, title;
